_doc: The skip ratchet (pre-release skip audit): every skip reason in the test tree must match a pattern here, and every entry must still be in use. A new skip with a new reason FAILS the gate until it is classified and justified below (or fixed). Classes: platform (OS/tool-gated), env (opt-in creds/services), split-guard (#82 split repo lacks monorepo artifacts BY DESIGN; no-ops in the monorepo), scenario-matrix (sparse corpus cells — the pre-release burn-down backlog), staging (parser/wasm staging state).
